parsed.name: 量子中央控制器
parsed.description: 用于量子比特实验控制的硬件控制器。该设备通过 SCPI 接口与上位机通信，可管理控制参数、处理 QISA 指令与控制存储内容，并支持数字 I/O 协议校准，用于协调量子实验中的时序与触发。
parsed.description_en: A hardware controller for qubit experiment control. It communicates with host software through SCPI, manages control parameters, handles QISA instructions and control-store contents, and supports digital I/O protocol calibration for coordinating timing and triggering in quantum experiments.
